subject.title: improve(android): move Wear agent, session, and model pickers to Home

question: Should Wear permanently replace its separate Agent and Session pages with Home-based compact pickers and expose `model-controls` through the companion protocol?
rationale: This is a coherent, user-visible navigation and companion-contract expansion, but the repository policy treats protocol and product-surface direction as owner decisions rather than an autonomous repair choice.

options.title: Approve the Home-first contract
options.body: Accept the three-page navigation and additive capability-gated model RPCs as the supported Wear companion design.

options.title: Keep separate context pages
options.body: Retain the existing page architecture and narrow this PR to any independently desired protocol or state fixes.

options.title: Request a smaller protocol boundary
options.body: Keep Home controls but define a narrower owner-approved companion API before merging the model-selection surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the Home-first contract
recommendation.body: Accept the three-page navigation and additive capability-gated model RPCs as the supported Wear companion design.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent implementation ownership and current assignment connect this person most directly to the Android/Wear navigation and protocol decision.
